coverage: All seventeen scenes in both original-en and modern-en: named cast, speaking and stage roles, contextual unnamed relatives, prison-list names, and named classical and religious references.

entities.name: The Duke of Vienna
entities.body: The ruler of Vienna, who puts his authority into Angelo’s hands as the play opens.

snapshots.body: Vienna’s Duke, who means to stay in the city disguised as a friar rather than travel abroad.
Vienna’s Duke, who has moved through the city as a friar under the name Lodowick.

entities.name: Angelo
entities.body: A magistrate of strict reputation, left as the Duke’s deputy to govern Vienna.

snapshots.body: The Duke’s deputy, now married to Mariana.

entities.name: Isabella
entities.body: Claudio’s sister, a novice entering the sisterhood of Saint Clare; she has not yet taken her vows.

entities.name: Claudio
entities.body: A young gentleman of Vienna, Isabella’s brother, arrested for getting Juliet with child.

entities.name: Lucio
entities.body: A gentleman of Vienna and a friend of Claudio’s, at home in the city’s brothels.

entities.name: Escalus
entities.body: An experienced counsellor of Vienna, placed second to Angelo in the Duke’s absence.

entities.name: Mariana
entities.body: The sister of Frederick, a soldier lost at sea.

snapshots.body: Angelo’s former betrothed, left by him when her dowry was lost at sea with her brother.
Angelo’s wife, married to him at the Duke’s order.

entities.name: The Provost
entities.body: The officer in charge of the Vienna prison.

entities.name: Pompey Bum
entities.body: Tapster to Mistress Overdone and a bawd in her house.

snapshots.body: Mistress Overdone’s tapster, now taken on to assist the prison executioner.

entities.name: Juliet
entities.body: The woman Claudio has got with child.

snapshots.body: Claudio’s partner, bound to him by a private contract but lacking a formal wedding.
Claudio’s partner; Isabella calls her cousin, though the tie is a schoolgirl adoption rather than blood.

entities.name: Mistress Overdone
entities.body: The keeper of a house of prostitution in the Vienna suburbs.

entities.name: Elbow
entities.body: A constable of Vienna, given to mangling the words he reaches for.

entities.name: Master Froth
entities.body: A gentleman of eighty pounds a year, brought in as a customer of Mistress Overdone’s house.

entities.name: Abhorson
entities.body: The executioner of the Vienna prison.

entities.name: Barnardine
entities.body: A prisoner in the Vienna jail, set to die on the same morning as Claudio.

snapshots.body: A Bohemian-born prisoner of nine years’ standing, condemned for a murder he does not deny.

entities.name: Francisca
entities.body: A nun of the sisterhood Isabella is entering.

entities.name: Friar Thomas
entities.body: The friar from whom the Duke asks a friar’s habit and instruction.

entities.name: Friar Peter
entities.body: A friar of the Duke’s acquaintance, sent for to carry out his instructions.

entities.name: Varrius
entities.body: A friend who meets the Duke outside the city on his return.

entities.name: The First Gentleman
entities.body: One of two gentlemen trading jokes with Lucio in the street.

entities.name: The Second Gentleman
entities.body: The other of the two gentlemen with Lucio in the street.

entities.name: The Justice
entities.body: A magistrate who sits with Escalus at the hearing.

entities.name: Angelo’s servant
entities.body: A servant in Angelo’s house who carries word of callers to him.

entities.name: Angelo’s messenger
entities.body: Angelo’s man, sent to the prison with his sealed order.

entities.name: The boy
entities.body: The boy who sings for Mariana.

entities.name: The officers
entities.body: The officers who make the arrests and guard the prisoners.

entities.name: The attendants
entities.body: The attendants who wait on the Duke and are sent on his errands.

entities.name: The lords
entities.body: The lords of the Duke’s court.

entities.name: The citizens
entities.body: The citizens who gather at the gate for the Duke’s return.

entities.name: Frederick
entities.body: Mariana’s brother, a soldier lost at sea with his sister’s dowry aboard.

entities.name: Ragozine
entities.body: A pirate who died of a fever in the Vienna prison.

entities.name: Mistress Kate Keepdown
entities.body: A woman Lucio promised to marry after getting her with child.

entities.name: Bridget
entities.body: A woman of Mistress Overdone’s house, named in Lucio’s teasing of Pompey.

entities.name: Mistress Elbow
entities.body: Elbow’s wife, who is with child; the hearing turns on what happened to her, but she never appears.

entities.name: Flavius
entities.body: A man in Vienna whom the Duke calls on first as he prepares to re-enter the city.

entities.name: Valentius
entities.body: One of the men in Vienna the Duke sends word to before entering.

entities.name: Rowland
entities.body: One of the men in Vienna the Duke sends word to before entering.

entities.name: Crassus
entities.body: One of the men in Vienna the Duke sends word to before entering; not the Roman of that name.

entities.name: Master Rash
entities.body: A young man imprisoned over a debt run up on brown paper and old ginger.

entities.name: Master Caper
entities.body: A young man imprisoned at the suit of Three-pile the mercer.

entities.name: Master Three-pile
entities.body: A mercer, and the creditor who has had Caper imprisoned.

entities.name: Dizy
entities.body: A young man among the prisoners Pompey recognises from the house he worked in.

entities.name: Master Deep-vow
entities.body: One of the prisoners Pompey recognises as an old customer.

entities.name: Master Copper-spur
entities.body: One of the prisoners Pompey recognises as an old customer.

entities.name: Master Starve-lackey
entities.body: A prisoner Pompey names as a rapier and dagger man.

entities.name: Drop-heir
entities.body: A young prisoner who killed Pudding.

entities.name: Pudding
entities.body: The man Drop-heir killed.

entities.name: Master Forthlight
entities.body: A prisoner Pompey names as a tilter.

entities.name: Master Shooty
entities.body: A prisoner Pompey names as a great traveller.

entities.name: Half-can
entities.body: A prisoner who stabbed Pots.

entities.name: Pots
entities.body: The man Half-can stabbed.

entities.name: Julius Caesar
entities.body: The Roman general and ruler whose triumphs Escalus and Lucio invoke when teasing Pompey about his name.

entities.name: Hannibal
entities.body: The Carthaginian general who marched on Rome; Elbow reaches for “cannibal” and lands on this name instead.

entities.name: Pygmalion
entities.body: The sculptor of Greek myth whose statue was brought to life as a woman.

entities.name: Jove
entities.body: The Roman king of the gods, also called Jupiter.

entities.name: Iniquity
entities.body: The Vice of the old morality plays, a stock figure of mischief set against Justice.

entities.name: Saint Clare
entities.body: Clare of Assisi, founder of the order of nuns Isabella is entering.

entities.name: Saints Philip and Jacob
entities.body: The apostles Philip and James, whose shared feast day fixes how old the child is.

entities.name: The Mother
entities.body: The superior of the convent Isabella is entering.

entities.name: The King of Hungary
entities.body: The king whose war with the dukes the gentlemen joke about; he is never named.

entities.name: The Emperor of Russia
entities.body: The Russian emperor, named only by title in a rumour about where the Duke has gone.

entities.name: The Pope
entities.body: The Pope, named only as “his Holiness” in the errand the disguised Duke claims to be on.

entities.name: Lucio’s child
entities.body: Lucio’s child by Kate Keepdown, a year and a quarter old and kept by Mistress Overdone.

entities.name: The father of Claudio and Isabella
entities.body: Their late father, remembered by Escalus as a noble man and by Isabella at his grave.

entities.name: Froth’s father
entities.body: Froth’s father, who died at Hallowmas and left him his eighty pounds a year.
